title: Implement the bounded Profile destination and canonical-route proof
verify: FT-007-AC-007: shell links resolve exactly to protected /home, /classes, /statistics, and /profile, while Logout continues to submit to existing POST /auth/logout.

/profile displays only server-owned fullName, role, and immutable registeredAt from the current-actor profile query and exposes no editing, password/provider management, membership management, or writes.
Authenticated canonical-route navigation succeeds; anonymous and revoked requests fail closed; logout revokes the session and returns to /login under disposable browser proof.
evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-007 / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: any shell href is non-canonical, a protected route exposes anonymous/revoked data, /profile reads Identity & Access persistence directly, Profile omits or exceeds its three fields, mutation controls appear, or logout leaves the session valid; GREEN: focused route and owned-server disposable browser tests prove exact hrefs, all four destinations, current-actor-query-only Profile access, exact read-only fields, denial matrix, logout revocation/redirect, cleanup, and unchanged study-calendar.db; artifact: .tasks/TASK-098-T3-FT-007-W31/ and .protocols/TASK-098-T3-FT-007-W31/.
purpose: Complete the accepted Profile user outcome and prove that the entire navigation shell targets the canonical protected routes.
success_outcome: An authenticated actor can navigate the exact four canonical destinations and view a bounded read-only Profile, while anonymous and revoked actors receive no protected data.
anti_goals: Do not add Profile editing, password/provider management, membership management, or persistence.
Do not change Home, Classes, Statistics, logout, or profile-query behavior already owned by dependency tasks beyond wiring the shell's canonical hrefs.
Do not introduce aliases, redirects, alternate route identities, or a new logout endpoint.
constraints: Profile consumes only the current-actor Identity & Access query; it never reads account persistence directly.
Canonical navigation identities are exactly /home, /classes, /statistics, and /profile; logout remains POST /auth/logout.
This task proves dependency outcomes only as route integration and adopts no provider-internal claim.
invariants: Profile displays exactly fullName, role, and registeredAt and performs no write.
All four canonical pages are protected by server actor context.
Revoked/logout sessions cannot recover protected data on a subsequent request.
verification_targets: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-007: exact href/destination matrix, exact Profile fields, absent mutation controls, anonymous/revoked denial, logout closure, and disposable-state isolation.

stop_conditions: Stop if Profile requires a new field, mutation, account recovery rule, or direct persistence access.
Stop if canonical navigation requires an alias, redirect policy, new logout path, or non-disposable browser state.
